description: This file defines a custom Akka mailbox implementation for handling PolicyModifyCommand messages within a policy persistence actor system. It enforces a capacity limit on the mailbox to prevent excessive queuing of modification commands, rejecting requests when the capacity is exceeded, and allows normal enqueuing of other message types.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorMailbox
classes.description: Custom Akka mailbox type for handling policy modification commands with capacity control.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorMailbox.PolicyPersistenceActorMessageQueue
classes.description: Message queue implementation that enforces capacity limits and handles special enqueue logic for PolicyModifyCommand messages.

methods.name: PolicyPersistenceActorMailbox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mailbox with capacity based on configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create instances of the message queue.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues messages, with special handling for PolicyModifyCommand to enforce capacity.

methods.name: enqueueFirst
methods.description: Enqueues messages at the front of the queue, with special handling for PolicyModifyCommand.

methods.name: queueSizeBasedAction
methods.description: Checks mailbox size and either adds the message or rejects it by sending an error response.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the next message from the queue.

methods.name: numberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns the current size of the queue.

methods.name: hasMessages
methods.description: Checks if the queue has any messages.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Clears the queue, sending all messages to dead letters.
